$DOGE = designed as an inflationary currency (always new coins, but inflation % drops with time).
$DOG = designed as a scarcity-based meme token on Bitcoin, with a hard cap and more speculation-driven appeal.

Max supply is fixed (scarcity-driven), unlike Dogecoin’s infinite supply.

Launched fairly via community airdrop (no presale, no team allocation).

Functions more like a limited-supply meme asset than a transactional coin.

1. Tokenomics & Supply Model
Dogecoin $DOGE

No maximum supply — inflationary by design.

Fixed issuance of 5 billion DOGE per year, indefinitely.

Because supply grows but issuance is fixed, the inflation rate decreases over time (e.g., ~3.4% in 2025 → ~1.9% in 2050). https://t.co/0LYbltf96f
